description: This file defines a front-end component for a notes application built with Qwik. It manages notes state, handles CRUD operations through imported API functions, and renders a UI with a sidebar, notes list, and editor.

methods.name: refresh$
methods.description: Fetches and sorts notes from the server, updating local state.

methods.name: onAddNote$
methods.description: Creates a new note optimistically and syncs with the server.

methods.name: onSelect$
methods.description: Sets the selected note by ID.

methods.name: onDelete$
methods.description: Deletes a note both locally and on the server, with rollback on failure.

methods.name: onSave$
methods.description: Saves updates to a note with optimistic UI updates.

methods.name: onSearch$
methods.description: Performs a search for notes and updates filtered view.
